title: Tile-only naming ships any non-empty display name that passes the aligner's small non-person list, so org, role, device and decorated names become speaker names with basis tile-only (allowTileOnly defaults true)
evidence: Checker, commit 8a1155f, real alignTileNamesToTurns over a 60 s single-label log then fuseSpeakerNames, turn text with no introduction. NAMED tile-only: "Vidysea", "Acme Corp", "Sales Team", "Admissions", "Marketing", "Support", "Office", "Student", "Parent", "Tablet", "Samsung S21", "Redmi Note 9", "User 1", "J", "Q&A", "Otter.ai", "hello@vidysea.com", "Rahul | Vidysea", "Priya (Vidysea)", "Priya - Vidysea", "Priya Nair (she/her)", "Careers Counselor", "VIDYSEA ADMISSIONS TEAM", "Dr. Priya", "Mr. Rahul Verma". Refused only: iPhone, Guest, Room 3, Zoom User, Admin, Unknown, Meeting Room, phone numbers, MacBook/Galaxy forms. fuseSpeakerNames has no name-shape check on the tile name and passes no isNonPersonName to the aligner. No test covers a junk tile name.
fix_direction: Do not default tile-only on: allowTileOnly default false, or require a person-shape gate on the tile name before tile-only (no digits, @ . | ( ) & , 1-4 alphabetic tokens, no title-only; reuse the self-id name-shape check) and strip or refuse titles; add the listed names as must-refuse tile-only cases.

fix_direction: Add namesAgree(Raj, Rajesh Kumar)=false, namesAgree(Ana, Anais)=false, and a fuse case tile Priya Nair + intro Priya Sharma -> none tile-intro-conflict.

title: Single-token title or surname tile agrees with a fuller intro (Dr vs Dr Priya, Kumar vs Rajesh Kumar) and a returned name may carry a title (Dr. Priya); one intro in a merged label names every turn of that label
evidence: Checker probes: namesAgree(Dr, Dr Priya)=true; tile Dr. Priya + intro Priya -> Dr. Priya/agree; label spk:0 with one intro turn and a later unintroduced turn names both turns. Inherent to label-level naming.
